description: A level 60 Shadow Priest's gear: full Vestments of Prophecy with Anathema and Skul's Ghastly Touch, from a sixtyupgrades.com set the owner supplied. Season of Discovery items. MOST OF THIS SET'S SPELL POWER IS SHADOW-ONLY and the engine has a single school-blind spellPower, so it is carried as unmodelled text rather than applied -- see src/data/items/README.md.

items.name: Crown of Prophecy

effects.text: Increases damage done by Shadow spells and effects by up to 39.
Improves your chance to get a critical strike with all spells and attacks by 1%.
(2) You may cast Flash Heal while in Shadowform.
(4) Increases your critical strike chance with spells and attacks by 2%.
(6) Mind Blast critical strikes reduce the duration of your next Mind Flay by 50% while increasing its total damage by 25%.
